text: @gitdek's watchers run Codex at xhigh, with a high fallback, since 2026-11-03. He asked for xhigh unless the work needed ultra. It stayed at ultra until #445's build of the recovery core ended, since a proved core is where the extra thinking pays most. At ultra, drafts took 35 to 105 minutes and builds up to four hours, which slowed every issue behind them. A watcher's effort is one flag for all its issues, so a proved core built later runs at xhigh too; -codex-effort raises it again. The default stays ultra, for a factory that sets nothing.
